description: This Dart source file defines a global navigation service for a Flutter application. It provides static methods to perform navigation actions such as pushing named routes and popping to the root before navigating, all without requiring a BuildContext.

classes.name: NavigationService
classes.description: A singleton-like class providing static methods for navigation that can be used without a BuildContext. It manages a global navigator key to perform route operations.

methods.name: pushNamed
methods.description: Pushes a named route onto the navigator stack if the navigator is available.

methods.name: popToRootAndPushNamed
methods.description: Pops all routes until the first, then pushes the specified named route. Useful for navigation to top-level screens.
